template_meta.template_name: Forum Community System Business Requirement Template

business_background.summary: User discussions, experience sharing, and Q&A content are currently scattered across chat groups, spreadsheets, and temporary documents. Content is hard to retain, search is weak, and policy violations rely on manual patrol. A forum community system similar to Tieba is needed to support threaded discussions, board governance, content moderation, and community analytics.
pain_points: Discussion content is hard to structure, retain, and search later
Boards, threads, replies, and user relations lack unified management
Violation discovery and handling are not timely, and moderation lacks audit trails
Trending content, active users, and community quality lack dashboards

objectives: Build a board and thread structure organized by interest or business topic
Support a closed interaction loop for posting, replying, liking, collecting, following, and notifications
Build content governance for reports, moderation, bans, appeals, and operation audits
Accumulate community operation data for recommendation and operating decisions
metrics: Average time from publishing to visibility within 3 seconds
Reduce average moderation handling time by 50%
Improve community search hit rate to 90%
Track daily active users and post volume by core board

in_scope: Thread publishing, editing, deletion, pinning, and featured posts
Replies, comments, nested replies, and interactions
User profile, following, levels, points, and badges
Reports, moderation, blocking, bans, and appeals
Search, sorting, recommendation, and analytics dashboards

target_roles: Visitor: browse public boards and threads, search content
Registered user: publish threads, reply, like, collect, follow, and report
Board moderator: manage board rules, pin/feature posts, and handle violations
Reviewer: review new posts, reports, and sensitive content
Operator: configure recommendations, campaigns, tags, and dashboards
System administrator: maintain permissions, dictionaries, sensitive words, and system parameters
core_scenarios: A user enters the forum home page and navigates to an interesting thread by board, hot list, or search.
A registered user publishes a thread in a target board and uploads images or attachments.
Other users reply, like, collect, or follow the author, and the system sends interaction notifications.
A user reports violating content, and a reviewer handles it in the moderation console with a recorded reason.
A moderator pins or features a quality post, while an operator configures recommendation slots.
Management views post volume, reply volume, active users, reports, and moderation efficiency.

functional_requirements.overview: This requirement covers seven capability groups: board governance, content publishing, interactions, user growth, moderation and risk control, search and recommendation, and community analytics.

features.description: Maintain board categories, board profiles, rules, moderators, and access permissions.
features.trigger: An operator creates or adjusts a board.
logic: Support board creation, disabling, merging, sorting, and visibility configuration
Support board rules, announcements, tags, and moderator permissions
Support board statistics and anomaly alerts
features.inputs: Board name, category, rules, moderators, permission scope
features.outputs: Board detail, announcement, moderator list, statistics
features.exceptions: Duplicate board name, deletion blocked when posts exist, permission conflict warnings

features.description: Support thread publishing, drafts, rich text, images, attachments, and tags.
features.trigger: A user clicks publish or edit.
logic: Support title, body, images, attachments, tags, and anonymous options
Support draft saving, edit history, deletion, and recovery
Support pinning, featuring, locking, and burying posts
features.inputs: Title, body, board, tags, attachments, author
features.outputs: Thread, draft, edit record, management status
features.exceptions: Sensitive word hit, attachment limit exceeded, duplicate posting, no permission

features.description: Support replies, nested comments, likes, collections, follows, and notifications.
features.trigger: A user interacts with a thread or reply.
logic: Support reply sorting, quoting, folding, and deletion
Support likes, collections, following authors/threads, and interaction notifications
Support blocking users and not-interested feedback
features.exceptions: Frequent action limit, blocked user restriction, content deleted

features.description: Maintain user profile, levels, points, badges, and contribution records.
features.trigger: A user completes posting, interaction, check-in, or campaign tasks.
logic: Support point rules, level rules, badge issuing, and task configuration
Show posts, collections, following, and followers on user profile
Support violation point deduction, mute, and credit recovery
features.inputs: User profile, behavior record, point rule, badge rule
features.outputs: User profile, point ledger, level result, badge record
features.exceptions: Point farming, point rollback, account anomaly

features.description: Handle sensitive content, reports, manual reviews, bans, and appeals.
features.trigger: Content is published, reported, or hits a rule.
logic: Support pre/post-publish moderation, sensitive words, and image review
Support report acceptance, conclusion, penalty action, and notification
Support bans, mutes, content blocking, appeals, and operation audit
features.inputs: Content, report reason, moderation rule, handler
features.outputs: Moderation result, penalty record, appeal record, audit log
features.exceptions: False-positive appeal, duplicate report, moderation timeout, penalty reversal

features.description: Provide content search, hot lists, recommendation slots, and community data.
features.trigger: A user searches content or an operator views data.
logic: Support search by board, keyword, tag, author, and time
Support hot thread list, recommendation slots, featured area, and campaign entry
Support dashboards for posts, active users, reports, and moderation efficiency
features.inputs: Threads, replies, tags, user behavior, moderation records
features.outputs: Search results, hot list, recommendation list, analytics report
features.exceptions: Index delay, recommended violating content, incomplete permission filtering

pages.elements: Recommended boards, hot list, search box, campaign entry
pages.actions: Search, enter board, view hot threads, sign in/up
pages.flow: A user enters the home page and opens threads by interest or hot list.

pages.elements: Board announcement, rules, thread list, filters and sorting
pages.actions: Publish thread, follow board, filter, view thread
pages.flow: A user browses threads in a board and starts discussion.

pages.elements: Main post, replies, nested replies, interactions, recommendations
pages.actions: Reply, like, collect, report, follow author
pages.flow: A user reads and interacts with a thread; the system records relations and notifications.

pages.elements: Title, body, images, attachments, tags, publish settings
pages.flow: A user edits content, and the system validates sensitive words and permissions before publishing.

pages.elements: Pending content, report list, handling records, penalty actions
pages.actions: Review, block, ban, reject, approve, notify
pages.flow: A reviewer handles content and leaves operation records.

pages.elements: Post volume, active users, hot threads, report volume, moderation efficiency
pages.actions: Filter, drill down, export, configure recommendations
pages.flow: Operators review community quality and growth.

rules: Posting frequency limits can be configured by user level within each board.
Publishing requires sensitive word, image safety, and permission checks.
Deleted or blocked content is hidden from normal users, while audit records remain in the admin backend.
Report handling must record handler, time, conclusion, and penalty action.
Pinning, featuring, and recommendation slots must be authorized by role.
key_data: Board: id, name, category, rules, moderators, status, visibility scope
Thread: id, board, title, body, author, status, interaction count, publish time
Reply: id, thread, parent reply, author, body, status, floor number
User relation: follow, block, collection, like, view record
Moderation record: content, rule, hit item, handler, conclusion, penalty action
Operation config: recommendation slot, hot list rule, tag, campaign entry

items: Performance: common home and thread detail queries return within 3 seconds; hot lists may be cached.
Security: protect identity, sensitive words, image content, and API frequency.
Usability: key flows such as posting, replying, and reporting need retry handling and clear prompts.
Audit: moderation, bans, deletion, recovery, and recommendation operations must be logged.
Extensibility: boards, tags, points, and moderation rules need configurable extension.

risks: Open communities may produce spam, ads, and violating content; governance strategy must be clear.
Overly strict sensitive word and moderation rules may hurt normal discussion.
Opaque hot list and recommendation rules may create operations disputes.
Historical content migration may require data cleansing and permission mapping.
open_questions: Should visitors be allowed to post, or only registered users?
Should posts be reviewed before publishing or inspected after publishing?
What are the permission boundaries and appointment process for board moderators?
Are levels, points, badges, and check-ins required?
Who maintains hot list, recommendation slot, and search ranking rules?

milestones.acceptance: Confirm roles, scope, core flows, and moderation strategy
Complete prototypes for home, board, thread, editor, and moderation console
Complete core features and integrations with content safety and search
Pilot selected boards and close issues
Complete full release, operation configuration, and acceptance
